checks.rule: The Environment Agency composite DTM covers about 99% of England at 1 m spatial resolution.
The DTM represents terrain after surface objects are removed from the DSM.
The 2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Where repeat surveys exist, the newest best-resolution data is used in the composite.
Resampled data used bilinear interpolation before merging.
Composite source surveys span 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
GeoTIFF raster tiles are aligned to the OS National Grid.
Elevation values are in metres and referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
The composite uses the OSTN15 transformation method / EPSG:27700 grid context.
Individual surveys used in the composite had vertical accuracy of ±15 cm RMSE.
Require the metadata survey index for each sampled parcel so survey date/provenance is not lost.
Do not treat 1 m cell size as 1 m vertical accuracy; retain the stated ±15 cm RMSE separately.
